avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces daclatasvir plasma concentrations significantly, compromising antiviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discontinue at least 2 weeks before daclatasvir initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifampicin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer decreases daclatasvir concentration by approximately 50%, reducing therapeutic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if essential, increase daclatasvir dose to 90 mg daily under physician supervision

avoid_supplements.name: Carbamazepine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer substantially reduces daclatasvir bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use alternative anticonvulsant; if unavoidable, monitor HCV RNA levels closely

avoid_supplements.name: Phenytoin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer decreases daclatasvir plasma levels
avoid_supplements.action: Consider alternative anticonvulsant; if used together, increase daclatasvir monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may moderately affect daclatasvir levels
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor treatment response with HCV RNA levels

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild P-glycoprotein inhibition may increase daclatasvir exposure
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously and monitor for adverse effects

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (taken without food optimization)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Food significantly increases daclatasvir absorption; inconsistent administration may reduce efficacy
avoid_foods.action: Take daclatasvir with food consistently at the same time daily for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase daclatasvir plasma concentration moderately
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; not absolutely contraindicated but monitor for increased adverse effects

caution_foods.name: Pomegranate juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase daclatasvir levels
caution_foods.action: Occasional consumption acceptable; excessive intake should be avoided

monitoring_notes: Daclatasvir requires consistent food intake for optimal absorption and is highly dependent on CYP3A4 metabolism; concurrent use of strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly compromises viral suppression. Monitor HCV RNA levels at weeks 4, 12, and end-of-treatment, and assess for hepatotoxicity, particularly in patients with cirrhosis or concurrent hepatitis B infection.
